name: an italic wordmark settles with a quiet tagline
looks: On a plain light field, a large italic serif wordmark fades and settles centred, a short tagline fading in beneath it a beat later, and the destination address resting quietly at the very bottom.
build: wordmark-assemble's settle stage only: the wordmark fades and rises a few px into place on one slow spring, the tagline revealing with a simple fade a beat behind, the URL fading in last and smallest.
sound: Near silence, one soft resolving tone.
prompt: Close on a large italic serif wordmark settling centred on a plain field, with a short, quiet tagline fading in beneath it and the destination address resting small at the very bottom. Keep the whole close calm, editorial and unhurried.
